refuted_statements_added.cex-tdmath-noncompact-mixture-nonattainm: For every nonempty Borel generator set $K$ and continuous energy $a:K\to\mathbb R$ bounded below, the unconstrained infimum of $\int_Ka\,dP$ over Borel probability measures on $K$ is attained whenever it is finite, without a compactness or coercivity hypothesis.
refuted_statements_added.cex-tdmath-nonconcave-ensemble-inequival: For every sequence of finite systems with admissible exact-group microcanonical energy densities tending to an interior value $e$, there is a fixed positive inverse temperature for which the canonical energy density concentrates at $e$ as system size tends to infinity, without further hypotheses such as entropy concavity.
refuted_statements_added.cex-tdmath-nonergodic-volume-flow: Every nonzero-time map of a complete Hamiltonian flow preserving finite symplectic volume is ergodic with respect to the normalized volume measure.
refuted_statements_added.cex-td-noncompact-phase-mixture-no-attai: Every nonempty feasible family of Borel probability mixtures on a noncompact phase-generator domain, with a prescribed barycenter and bounded positive continuous concave generator entropy, attains its finite entropy supremum without an additional compactness or coercivity hypothesis.
refuted_statements_added.cex-td-clapeyron-zero-volume-jump: Equality of two smooth one-component molar Gibbs branches near a coexistence point always defines a unique differentiable pressure graph $p=p(T)$ on an open temperature interval, with slope $\Delta s/\Delta v$, even when the molar-volume jump $\Delta v$ vanishes.
refuted_statements_added.cex-tdmath-bulk-field-pressure: At fixed activity $z>0$ and inverse temperature $\beta>0$, adding any spatially constant one-particle external energy throughout a continuum ideal-gas region leaves the thermodynamic-limit log grand partition sum per volume unchanged, as would a negligible boundary perturbation.
